name: Idelium demo DSL full component coverage
description: Open https://idelium.org/demo/ and exercise the browser component families supported by Idelium DSL v1 with stable data-testid selectors. The import is split into granular Idelium steps so execution results match the Selenium example detail level.

steps.name: Open Idelium demo page
steps.description: Open https://idelium.org/demo/ and verify the main demo container is ready.

steps.name: Open Idelium demo page
steps.source:
idelium 1.0

# Browser-only DSL coverage for https://idelium.org/demo/.
# DSL v1 intentionally avoids custom JavaScript, alert handling, iframe switching,
# Shadow DOM traversal, native select mutation, and Postman execution. Those
# surfaces remain covered by the native JSON/Postman examples until DSL v1 grows
# dedicated commands for them.
test "Open Idelium demo page" {
    let baseUrl = "https://idelium.org/demo/"

    open "${baseUrl}"
    wait css "[data-testid='selenium-demo-page']" visible timeout 15s
    assert url contains "idelium.org/demo"
}
steps.note: Open https://idelium.org/demo/ and verify the main demo container is ready.

steps.name: Exercise form controls
steps.description: Fill the demo form, verify field values, toggle target choices, and submit the form.

steps.name: Exercise form controls
steps.source:
idelium 1.0

# Browser-only DSL coverage for https://idelium.org/demo/.
# DSL v1 intentionally avoids custom JavaScript, alert handling, iframe switching,
# Shadow DOM traversal, native select mutation, and Postman execution. Those
# surfaces remain covered by the native JSON/Postman examples until DSL v1 grows
# dedicated commands for them.
test "Exercise form controls" {
    wait css "[data-testid='demo-form']" visible timeout 10s
    write css "[data-testid='name-input']" value "Ada Lovelace"
    write css "[data-testid='email-input']" value "ada@example.org"
    assert value css "[data-testid='name-input']" equals "Ada Lovelace"
    assert value css "[data-testid='email-input']" contains "ada@example.org"
    click css "[data-testid='target-web-radio']"
    click css "[data-testid='target-api-radio']"
    click css "[data-testid='target-mobile-radio']"
    click css "[data-testid='terms-checkbox']"
    assert visible css "[data-testid='priority-range']"
    assert visible css "[data-testid='priority-value']"
    write css "[data-testid='notes-textarea']" value "Full Idelium demo coverage generated from the DSL import."
    assert value css "[data-testid='notes-textarea']" contains "DSL import"
    click css "[data-testid='submit-button']"
}
steps.note: Fill the demo form, verify field values, toggle target choices, and submit the form.
